value: NASA SMAP SPL3SMP_E v006 (NSIDC DAAC), Harmony HOSS spatial subset
Grid spacing is not independent 9 km measurement detail; a point selects a grid cell.
Not a rover-depth or field moisture substitute. AM and PM overpasses are separate retrievals.
Values are volumetric fraction: 0.30 means 30 percent.
soil_moisture_error and freeze_thaw_fraction are empty: the source subsets carry only the -9999 fill, which is stored as null rather than as a number.
